local function tl_chars(s)
  local out = {}
  local i = 1
  local n = #s
  while i <= n do
    local b0 = s:byte(i)
    local cp, extra
    if b0 < 0x80 then cp, extra = b0, 0
    elseif b0 & 0xE0 == 0xC0 then cp, extra = b0 & 0x1F, 1
    elseif b0 & 0xF0 == 0xE0 then cp, extra = b0 & 0x0F, 2
    else cp, extra = b0 & 0x07, 3
    end
    i = i + 1
    for _ = 1, extra do
      cp = (cp << 6) | (s:byte(i) & 0x3F)
      i = i + 1
    end
    out[#out + 1] = cp
  end
  return out
end

local function tl_quote(s)
  return '"' .. s:gsub('[%c"\\]', function(c)
    if c == '"' then return '\\"' end
    if c == '\\' then return '\\\\' end
    if c == '\n' then return '\\n' end
    if c == '\r' then return '\\r' end
    if c == '\t' then return '\\t' end
    return string.format('\\u%04x', c:byte())
  end) .. '"'
end
local v_status
function v_status(v_n)
  return (function() if (v_n > 0) then return "active" else return "inactive" end end)()
end

local function tl_quote(s)
  return '"' .. s:gsub('[%c"\\]', function(c)
    if c == '"' then return '\\"' end

local TL_2_32 <const> = 4294967296
-- Lua integers are 64-bit, so an Int has to be brought back into 32 bits after every operation.
-- `%` is floored here and the modulus is positive, so this is exact for negatives too.

# FizzBuzz to 100: one transformation, one string, printed as lines.
unlines(
    range(100) | map(. + 1) | map(
        "FizzBuzz" if . % 15 == 0 else
        "Fizz"     if . % 3 == 0  else
        "Buzz"     if . % 5 == 0  else
        str(.)
    )
)

local function tl_quote(s)
  return '"' .. s:gsub('[%c"\\]', function(c)
    if c == '"' then return '\\"' end
    if c == '\\' then return '\\\\' end
    if c == '\n' then return '\\n' end
    if c == '\r' then return '\\r' end
    if c == '\t' then return '\\t' end
    return string.format('\\u%04x', c:byte())
  end) .. '"'
end
local function tl_join(v, f)
  local parts = {}
  for i = 1, #v do parts[i] = f(v[i]) end
  return "[" .. table.concat(parts, ",") .. "]"

    return out

  return { some = v[i + 1] }

  return '"' .. s:gsub('[%c"\\]', function(c)
    if c == '"' then return '\\"' end

    if c == '\n' then return '\\n' end
    if c == '\r' then return '\\r' end

local function tl_quote(s)
  return '"' .. s:gsub('[%c"\\]', function(c)
    if c == '"' then return '\\"' end
    if c == '\\' then return '\\\\' end
    if c == '\n' then return '\\n' end

end
local function tl_join(v, f)
  local parts = {}
  for i = 1, #v do parts[i] = f(v[i]) end
  return "[" .. table.concat(parts, ",") .. "]"
